content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: after the \"Hedge Relationship\" menu item is clicked, a coverage overlay is shown within about 15 ms and the hedge relationship:screen navigation only arrives about 6 s later in all three sessions (click 24 to app:4 at 7830 ms, 25 to app:4 at 7937 ms, 25 to app:4 at 8183 ms), which suggests the route change is gated on work that finishes before the screen opens.", "fix": "Fix: In the Hedging menu, change the \"Hedge Relationship\" menuitem click handler so it navigates to the hedge relationship screen immediately, and move the blocking load that currently holds the overlay into that screen as an in-place loading state (for example a skeleton on the form fields) instead of waiting for it before the route change.", "cited_event_ids": ["24", "29:w28", "app:4", "25", "30:w33", "30:w31", "app:4"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The contents of the overlay or what the app waits on (no network or console events are present in the windows).", "Whether the delay is a data fetch, a permission check, or a script load.", "Whether the 6.5 s median loss is the same as the wait inside each window (taken from the insight facts, not recomputed).", "Whether the 18 clicks/keys during the waits were on the overlay or on other elements (not broken down in the windows)."]}
